arjun: flagging a new edge case from last night's stress test. when multiple policy rollouts overlap the fairness calc becomes non-deterministic and we saw two agents compute different normalized weights for the same tenant.
maria: that's worrying. any idea why?
arjun: root cause seems to be floating-point normalization + out-of-order apply. two diffs applied in different orders yield slightly different sums then normalized weights differ beyond our epsilon.
sam: classic. we should make normalization deterministic. options: fixed-point math, deterministic sort+apply order, or include a canonical reduction step on policy-service with signed snapshots.
maria: fixed-point sounds simplest and cheap. switch to int64 micro-weights (scale by 1e6).
arjun: agree. also add a versioned canonicalize step on policy-service: after computing weights, emit a canonical snapshot with normalization done server-side; agents accept only canonical snapshots or deltas referencing that canonical base.
sam: we should also add a lightweight verification step where agents compute hash of applied snapshot and compare to server-hash. if mismatch, agent should fetch full snapshot.
ops-bot: stress test summary: 05:00 window; 10k concurrent simulated tenants; 0.2% mismatch rate; affected flows: fairness calc.
maria: plan: 1) short-term: document deterministic normalization and add epsilon check in agents to detect divergence (1 week). 2) medium: switch to int64 scaled weights and server canonical snapshots (2-3 weeks). 3) long-term: signed canonical snapshots + verification and automated rollback if mismatch (Q2).
arjun: implications for storage: canonical snapshots will increase storage footprint. we can GC old snapshots after N versions.
sam: and for network cost, we can compress snapshots and offer incremental binary diffs with base_version references.
maria: please include canonical snapshot hash in Console so we can quickly tell which agents are on which version.
arjun: test matrix: randomized order apply tests, float->int migration test, and snapshot-hash mismatch simulation.
ops-bot: reminder: eng-platform review Thurs 15:00 PST
arjun: i'll send a PR with int64 conversion helpers and a proposal for snapshot hashing algorithm.
maria: i'll add monitoring for snapshot-hash mismatches and epsilon violations.
sam: i'll update agent SDK to surface deterministic normalization and add the hash check.
ops-bot: weekly eng-platform sync Friday 14:00 GMT
arjun: closing thread, reopen if we hit more mismatches.
